mapper.select: SELECT target_amount FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT forecast.forecast_id, forecast.expected_asset AS baseline_expected_asset, COALESCE(brokerage.current_balance, 0) AS brokerage_book_value, brokerage.last_synced_at AS brokerage_last_synced_at, goal.target_amount, profile.rank_name, profile.discharge_date, COALESCE(( SELECT saved.expected_return_rate FROM simulation saved WHERE saved.user_id = forecast.user_id AND saved.is_saved = TRUE ORDER BY saved.created_at DESC, saved.simulation_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS expected_return_rate FROM cashflow_forecast forecast INNER JOIN soldier_profile profile ON profile.user_id = forecast.user_id INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = forecast.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN connected_account brokerage ON brokerage.account_id = #{brokerageAccountId} AND brokerage.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE forecast.forecast_id = ( SELECT latest.forecast_id FROM cashflow_forecast latest WHERE latest.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY latest.generated_at DESC, latest.forecast_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
